tasks.title: Add migration v9 (promotion-classification) to database.ts
tasks.description: In src/core/database.ts: append `{ version: 9, name: 'promotion-classification', up: migratePromotionClassification }` to MIGRATIONS[] (lines 51-60) — LATEST_SCHEMA_VERSION auto-derives (line 62). Define `function migratePromotionClassification(db: Database.Database): void` mirroring migrateCoworkSupport (lines 400-404) — D-002 numbered-migration framework with swallowed try/catch ALTERs, NOT PRAGMA checks. Body exactly: `try { db.exec("ALTER TABLE memories ADD COLUMN promotion_target TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK(promotion_target IN ('none','adr','ddr','best_practice','recipe','note'))"); } catch {}` then `try { db.exec('ALTER TABLE memories ADD COLUMN promoted_to TEXT'); } catch {}` then `db.exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_memories_promotion ON memories(promotion_target) WHERE promotion_target != 'none'");`. CHECK-on-ALTER is valid in better-sqlite3. Existing rows auto-fill 'none' via the NOT NULL DEFAULT. Tabs for indentation.
